items.passage: Tom lives in a small town. Every morning, he rides his bike to school. His sister takes the bus because her school is far. On the weekend, the family drives a car to the beach. Last summer, they took a plane to visit Grandma. Tom likes trains best because they are fast.

items.advPassage: Yesterday, Ben and his mom went to the city by train. The train was fast and clean. In the city, they took a bus to the museum. After that, they walked to a park and ate ice cream. They came home by taxi because it was late. Ben had a fun day.
